description: Redraw a fighting-game DEFEAT pose: sitting slumped, dazed lopsided face, messy feathers or fur, small cheek bandage, one puffy purple eyelid, drooping wings or ears. Comically battered but lovable, alive. No blood, gore or missing limbs. Keep identity, anatomy, colors and accessories. Full body, front 3/4, transparent margins. Cute pixel art. No text, floor or shadows.
